agent_summary: In a scripted ground-aerial open-vocabulary search toy world, templated natural-language messaging was slightly slower than fixed-schema symbolic messaging pooled over query tiers (+1.28 steps, small success gain), with the gap moving toward language only on attribute and relational queries. A decomposition shows the benefit comes from attribute/relation content that an extended schema carries equally well, while room-level references cost about 2.3 steps; corruption hurt both channels and did not favour symbolic.
